mission: Take in the operations centre's tasking, supervisory command and recall, and the moving objects in a tasked area of interest, and send back triaged, merged detection reports, tracks, a status picture and a decision record for each report. Stay inside the airspace clearance and work through radio interference, loss of satellite positioning, bad weather and decoys, using a mesh radio, a ground link, recharge points, stored maps and the ground crew.
functionSentence: SurveillanceDroneSwarm moves the tasked area of interest from unwatched to continuously watched and reported.

stakeholders.name: DutyController
stakeholders.role: The single operator at the operations centre who tasks, supervises and recalls the swarm and acknowledges reports

stakeholders.name: Analysts
stakeholders.role: Operations centre staff who judge triaged alerts and decide which ones matter

stakeholders.name: OperationsCentre
stakeholders.role: Commissions surveillance missions and merges swarm reports with the fixed camera network's tracks

stakeholders.name: AirspaceAuthority
stakeholders.role: Says when and where the drones may fly

stakeholders.name: GroundCrew
stakeholders.role: Services and recharges the drones between sorties

stakeholders.name: FixedCameraNetworkOwner
stakeholders.role: Runs the existing camera network, whose tracks the swarm's tracks must merge with

stakeholders.name: ProgrammeSponsor
stakeholders.role: Pays for the fleet and holds the per-drone computing cost cap

environment.name: MissionTasking
environment.doc: The area of interest, its sectors and the mission window, set by the operations centre

environment.name: SupervisoryAndRecallCommands
environment.doc: Priorities, a sector to look at more closely, the reporting threshold, and recall-and-land for the whole swarm or one drone

environment.name: MovingObjectsInArea
environment.doc: The real objects in the area that have to be detected and classified

environment.name: CameraNetworkTracks
environment.doc: Tracks from the fixed camera network that the swarm's tracks are merged with at the operations centre

environment.name: ReportAcknowledgements
environment.doc: The operations centre's confirmation of each detection report

environment.name: DetectionReportsAndTracks
environment.doc: Triaged, de-duplicated detection reports and tracks with position and time, sent to the operations centre

environment.name: StatusPicture
environment.doc: Where every drone is, what it is doing, how much coverage there is and what is degraded

environment.name: DecisionRecords
environment.doc: For each report: the frames it came from, the classifier version, the reporting threshold in force and who acknowledged it

environment.name: AirspaceClearance
environment.doc: The airspace authority's limits on when and where the drones may fly

environment.name: RadioInterference
environment.doc: Interference that can degrade the mesh between drones and the link to the operations centre

environment.name: SatellitePositioningOutage
environment.doc: Satellite positioning can be unavailable for minutes at a time

environment.name: WeatherLightingAndDecoys
environment.doc: Wind above moderate forces a landing; lighting, weather and misleading paint or shapes degrade sensing

environment.name: OperatorWorkloadLimit
environment.doc: At most 20 alerts per hour, with at least 30 seconds for each

environment.name: ComputingCostCap
environment.doc: On-board classification computing costs no more than 300 USD per drone

environment.name: MeshRadio
environment.doc: Drone-to-drone radio that does not depend on the ground link and carries the coordination traffic

environment.name: GroundLinkRadio
environment.doc: Radio link between the swarm and the operations centre, which is not always available

environment.name: RechargePointAndGroundCrew
environment.doc: Where the drones land, recharge (about 60 minutes) and are serviced

environment.name: StoredMaps
environment.doc: Reference imagery a drone navigates against when satellite positioning is unavailable

environment.name: FleetOfTwelveDrones
environment.doc: The 12 identical drones that can be fielded, each flying about 40 minutes

capabilities.name: HoldContinuousWatch
capabilities.doc: Keep at least one drone watching every sector of the tasked area at all times, rotating drones through recharge

capabilities.name: DetectClassifyAndReport
capabilities.doc: Detect moving objects, classify them or say Unknown, and report them with position and time

capabilities.name: CoordinateSwarm
capabilities.doc: Let the drones settle among themselves, over the mesh, the handovers, rotation, redistribution, deconfliction, relay, track correlation and admission

capabilities.name: SuperviseSwarm
capabilities.doc: Let one operator task, supervise, recall and see the status of the whole swarm and acknowledge its reports

capabilities.name: OperateThroughLinkGap
capabilities.doc: Keep detecting while cut off from the operations centre, hold the reports and deliver them once the link is back, with none lost

capabilities.name: StayWithinClearedAirspace
capabilities.doc: Fly only inside the cleared airspace and weather limits, and land safely when that is not possible

capabilities.name: NavigateWithoutSatellitePositioning
capabilities.doc: Keep knowing where each drone is by matching camera views against stored maps

capabilities.name: TriageReports
capabilities.doc: Rank reports by how likely they are to matter and merge duplicates before they reach the operator

capabilities.name: KeepDecisionRecord
capabilities.doc: Record, for every report, its source frames, classifier version, reporting threshold and acknowledger

capabilities.name: ManageClassifierVersion
capabilities.doc: Keep one classifier version across the fleet and know which version each drone runs

moes.name: areaUnderWatchShare
moes.doc: Share of the area under watch at any moment; the brief requires at least 0.9.

moes.name: coverageLossOnMemberLoss
moes.doc: Share of coverage lost when one drone is lost, before the swarm re-spreads; the brief allows at most 0.25.

moes.name: jammedMeshAreaUnderWatchShare
moes.doc: Share of the area under watch with half the links between drones jammed; the brief requires at least 0.75.

moes.name: groundLinkLossAreaUnderWatchShare
moes.doc: Share of the area under watch while the ground link or the ground station is down. This is where coordination placement makes the biggest difference. The brief gives no number; the target is set here to the brief's continuous-watch figure of 0.9.

moes.name: watchEnduranceHours
moes.doc: How long the swarm holds the watch before it needs people. The brief gives no number; 24 h is a target set here.

moes.name: reportLatencySeconds
moes.doc: Age of a report when it reaches the operations centre with the link up; the brief allows at most 60 s.

moes.name: positionErrorWithoutGnssMeters
moes.doc: A drone's position error after 10 minutes without satellite positioning; the brief allows at most 50 m.

moes.name: reportHoldMinutes
moes.doc: How long a cut-off drone holds its reports; the brief requires at least 30 minutes.

moes.name: reportsLostInLinkGap
moes.doc: Number of reports lost across a link gap; the brief says none.

moes.name: missedDetectionShare
moes.doc: Share of real objects that go undetected; the brief allows at most 0.10.

moes.name: falseAlarmsPerHour
moes.doc: False alarms reaching the operator each hour; the brief allows at most 2.

moes.name: operatorAlertsPerHour
moes.doc: Alerts reaching the operator each hour after triage; the operator can judge at most 20.

moes.name: acknowledgedReportsThatMatterShare
moes.doc: Share of acknowledged reports that turn out to matter; the brief requires at least 0.8.

moes.name: onboardClassificationCostUsd
moes.doc: Cost of on-board classification computing per drone; the brief allows at most 300 USD.

moes.name: fleetSize
moes.doc: The number of drones that can be fielded; fixed by the brief at 12.

moes.name: operatorSecondsPerAlert
moes.doc: Time the operator needs to judge each alert; fixed by the brief at least 30 s.

moes.name: memberFlightEnduranceMinutes
moes.doc: How long one drone flies; fixed by the brief at about 40 minutes.

moes.name: memberRechargeMinutes
moes.doc: How long one drone takes to recharge; fixed by the brief at about 60 minutes.

moes.name: areaOfInterestKm2
moes.doc: Size of the area the design must cover; fixed by the brief at up to 25 km².

population.doc: Twelve identical surveillance drones. They have to settle handovers, recharge rotation, redistribution, deconfliction, relay, track correlation and admission among themselves over the mesh radio, so the watch survives when the ground link drops.

coordinationFunctions.name: handOverSector
coordinationFunctions.doc: A drone leaving to recharge hands its sector to one arriving, without a gap.

coordinationFunctions.name: rotateRecharge
coordinationFunctions.doc: Decide who goes to recharge next, so the airborne share never falls below what the sectors need.

coordinationFunctions.name: redistributeCoverage
coordinationFunctions.doc: When a drone is lost, the remaining drones re-spread over the sectors so the loss of coverage stays bounded.

coordinationFunctions.name: deconflictMembers
coordinationFunctions.doc: Keep drones apart in the air and at the recharge point.

coordinationFunctions.name: relayLink
coordinationFunctions.doc: A drone out of range of the ground station passes its reports and status through a neighbour.

coordinationFunctions.name: correlateTracks
coordinationFunctions.doc: When two drones see the same object, the swarm reports one track, not two.

coordinationFunctions.name: handOverTrack
coordinationFunctions.doc: When an object moves into the next sector, the drone watching that sector takes over the track without losing it.

coordinationFunctions.name: admitMember
coordinationFunctions.doc: A drone joins coordination only after the others have authenticated it; one that fails is quarantined until readmitted.

c2Functions.name: taskMission
c2Functions.doc: Set the area, its sectors and the mission window.

c2Functions.name: commandSupervision
c2Functions.doc: Set priorities, a sector to look at more closely, and the reporting threshold.

c2Functions.name: recallAndLand
c2Functions.doc: Recall and land the whole swarm or one drone, at any time.

c2Functions.name: presentStatusPicture
c2Functions.doc: Show where every drone is, what it is doing, how much coverage there is and what is degraded.

c2Functions.name: acknowledgeReport
c2Functions.doc: The operations centre confirms each detection report, so nothing is lost in a link gap.

hazards.name: PositionDriftHazard
hazards.doc: Without satellite positioning, a drone's position estimate drifts and its reports place objects in the wrong place.

hazards.name: MeshJammingHazard
hazards.doc: Interference cuts the links between drones, and coordination stalls.

hazards.name: MisclassificationHazard
hazards.doc: A detection is reported as the wrong class, or given a forced class where Unknown was the truth.

hazards.name: SensingDegradedUnnoticedHazard
hazards.doc: A sensor degrades and nobody knows the reports from it are unreliable.

hazards.name: StaleTrackHazard
hazards.doc: A track is shown as current after nothing has seen the object for a while.

hazards.name: SpoofedMemberHazard
hazards.doc: Something that is not one of the drones joins the mesh and takes part in coordination.

hazards.name: MixedClassifierVersionsHazard
hazards.doc: Drones run different classifier versions and classify the same object differently.

hazards.name: OperatorOverloadHazard
hazards.doc: More alerts reach the operator than they can judge, and they accept what is in front of them.

rules.name: RecallWins
rules.doc: Once a drone is recalled, it does not watch again until it has landed.

rules.name: ReturnsWhenIsolated
rules.doc: From any situation a drone can be in, it can always get back to landed; an isolated drone included.

rules.name: GeofenceBreachEndsWatch
rules.doc: Once a drone is outside its cleared airspace, it does not watch until it has landed.

rules.name: QuarantinedStaysOut
rules.doc: Once a drone is quarantined, it takes no part in coordination until it has been readmitted.

modes.name: NavigationDegraded
modes.doc: The drone has no satellite positioning and navigates by camera against stored maps.

modes.name: SensingDegraded
modes.doc: The drone's sensors cannot be trusted as they are.

modes.name: Isolated
modes.doc: The drone is cut off from the other drones.

modes.name: Quarantined
modes.doc: The drone failed admission and takes no part in coordination until readmitted.

modes.name: MeshDegraded
modes.doc: A share of the links between drones is jammed.

fields.name: objectClass
fields.doc: One of the known classes, or Unknown

fields.name: confidence
fields.doc: Classifier confidence in objectClass, from 0 to 1

fields.name: sensorId
fields.doc: The sensor that made the detection

fields.name: memberId
fields.doc: The drone that made the detection

fields.name: classifierVersion
fields.doc: The classifier version that produced the class

fields.name: lastSeenTime
fields.doc: When the object was last seen

fields.name: stale
fields.doc: Set once nothing has seen the object for 120 seconds

fields.name: frames
fields.doc: The frames the report came from

fields.name: classifierVersion
fields.doc: The classifier version that classified it

fields.name: reportingThreshold
fields.doc: The reporting threshold in force when the report was made

fields.name: acknowledgedBy
fields.doc: Who at the operations centre acknowledged the report

rationale:
The swarm takes over the job that the duty controller's watch assets do today: holding a sector, handing it over, recharging and relaying. So the operational entity is one representative watchAsset, typed by the SurveillanceDrone member definition. The brief sizes the population at 12 drones, which coordinate over a mesh radio that does not depend on the ground link. The mesh port and interface in Common follow the peer shape the layers below wire through.

Coordination between drones (8 functions) is kept apart from the operator's command and control (5 functions). That way both architectures the brief asks for (coordination at the ground station, or on the drones) can put the same functions in different places.

Hazards, rules, modes and the three items with listed fields (DetectionReport, Track, DecisionRecord) use the brief's names and nothing more.

Every number the brief asks the design to achieve is a scored #MoE with the brief's target. Two targets are set here because the brief gives none, and their docs say so: endurance at 24 h, and coverage with the ground link down at 0.9. Coverage with the link down is the measure where the two architectures differ most. Numbers the brief fixes are #Budget attributes and are not scored: fleet size, operator time per alert, flight and recharge times, and area size. This needs the extra kind Budget.
